checks.name: dataset_not_empty
checks.expectation: Dataset must contain at least one row.

checks.name: required_columns
checks.expectation: All required cleaned-data columns must be present; extra columns are allowed.

checks.name: paper_id_completeness
checks.expectation: paper_id must be non-empty for every row.

checks.name: title_completeness
checks.expectation: title must be non-empty for every row.

checks.name: summary_completeness
checks.expectation: summary must be non-empty for every row.

checks.name: summary_min_length
checks.expectation: Every summary must contain at least 100 characters.

checks.name: published_date_parseable
checks.expectation: published must be a parseable date for every row.

checks.name: future_published_dates
checks.expectation: published must not be later than the current UTC date.

checks.name: age_days_numeric
checks.expectation: age_days must be numeric for every row.

checks.name: age_days_non_negative
checks.expectation: age_days must be greater than or equal to zero.

checks.name: authors_joined_completeness
checks.expectation: authors_joined must be non-empty for every row.

checks.name: categories_joined_completeness
checks.expectation: categories_joined must be non-empty for every row.

checks.name: embedding_text_completeness
checks.expectation: text_for_embedding must be non-empty for every row.

checks.name: freshness_ratio
checks.expectation: At most 20% of records may be stale or have invalid dates.
